The '''1950 National Division''' was the 11th and last edition of the [[Turkish National Division]]. [[Fenerbahçe S.K. (football)|Fenerbahçe]] won their sixth title.

==Participants==

*[[Beşiktaş J.K.|Beşiktaş]] - [[Istanbul Football League]], 1st
*[[Fenerbahçe S.K. (football)|Fenerbahçe]] - [[Istanbul Football League]], 2nd
*[[Galatasaray S.K. (football)|Galatasaray]] - [[Istanbul Football League]], 3rd
*[[Vefa S.K.|Vefa]] - [[Istanbul Football League]], 4th
*[[Gençlerbirliği S.K.|Gençlerbirliği]] - [[Ankara Football League]], 1st
*[[Ankara Demirspor]] - [[Ankara Football League]], 2nd
*[[Göztepe S.K.|Göztepe]] - [[İzmir Football League]], 1st
*[[Altay S.K.|Altay]] - [[İzmir Football League]], 2nd
